reviews.title: Great, at first..
reviews.text:
I'm a UK user, i have to use a vpn to access some content. Last year, i bought a 1 year SurfShark subscription — everything went perfectly at first, fast connections, no issues with the app on either of my devices, I was quite pleased. However, nearing the end of my subscription, the service has gone entirely downhill and I won't be renewing my subscription. For the last month, i've had issue upon issue with this app. On iOS, one of the protocols for the Canada connection is broken and no longer works, X ignores the VPN sometimes (I have to play around with protocols to work (sometimes it doesn't, sometimes it does), and Connection issues on both devices. Stuttering, playback issues, it's ridiculous. The PC app isn't any better, there's a lot of bugs despite being updated pretty regularly. For example, AutoConnect leaves the connection at 0% when i turn on my pc, I have to manually reset this each time. I tried to explain this to a customer service representative the last time I got support, and I was completely ignored on that front. The more i've used SurfShark, the more hassle it has become. I would have recommended at the start of my plan, not so much now i'm nearing the end. All of these issues have coincided with my card details expiring and not having any
linked in-app... Despite the subscription still being valid for another month (at the time of expiry)

I'd find a different service. One that's reliable and doesn't break the second you don't have payment details on f

reviews.title: BROKE BOTH MY COMPUTERS
reviews.text: I am absolutely done with Surfshark after this. I've now had the exact same catastrophic failure on two separate machines, and the infuriating part is it's not even tied to uninstalling the thing. It happens completely out of nowhere while the app is just sitting there installed and supposedly working fine, your entire internet connection just dies, DNS errors, no connectivity, nothing, for absolutely no reason. Fixing it both times required a full Windows network reset and reinstalling network drivers completely from scratch just to get basic internet back. This is not a minor glitch, this is a fundamentally broken product that can silently destroy your entire system's connectivity with zero warning and zero explanation. For a company I'm supposed to trust with all of my network traffic and privacy, this level of unreliability is unacceptable. Avoid this VPN entirely unless you enjoy losing hours of your life to Windows network resets. Two strikes is enough for me, I'm done

reviews.title: Неправильно настроен IP адрес внутри приложения
reviews.text:
Крайне разочарована этим VPN.

Несколько дней подряд я подключалась к одной и той же стране через приложение. В интерфейсе каждый раз отображалось, что подключение выполнено именно к нужной мне стране, поэтому у меня не было причин сомневаться в его работе.

Однако позже выяснилось, что фактический IP-адрес был из совершенно другой страны. Из-за этого при публикации видео в TikTok мои входы определялись как выполненные из другой локации. Для меня это очень серьёзная проблема, потому что это может негативно повлиять на монетизацию и доход.

Самое неприятное, что я обнаружила это не сразу. Всё выглядело так, будто VPN работает корректно: приложение показывало нужную страну, но фактически использовался другой IP. Получается, я доверяла информации внутри приложения и понесла потенциальные финансовые последствия из-за его некорректной работы.

Если приложение показывает одну страну, а на самом деле выдаёт IP другой страны, это вводит пользователей в заблуждение. Я потеряла несколько дней, публикуя контент в уверенности, что нахожусь в нужной локации.

Очень недовольна. Не могу рекомендовать этот VPN тем, кому важна точность геолокации и стабильность работы.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work in China!
reviews.text:
This company claim that their VPN works in China, but I can safely say, being here on the ground, it is completely useless and ineffective.
I’m sure it works elsewhere in other countries, but don’t pay for a subscription if you’re planning to come here because you will not be able to connect to any locations and even if you do, the speed will be snails pace.

Also, they use the same generic reply whenever you habe a connection issue, they just send out an automated response which always says “have you considered using our manual wireguard?”
They talk about setting up this magical manual wireguard like it’s a saviour to all the problems.
I spent hours online talking to several members of their team, who kept passing me on to the next like a hot potato, and after several hours (I repeat, several hours) of installing, then uninstalling, then reinstalling their manual wireguard, it still didn’t work. Their manual wireguard involves going through even more hassle and more messing around, just to be stuck with a product that still doesn’t work.

If you’re travelling to other locations, it’ll probably work fine in other countries, but in China, it is a waste of money. I’m not even angry that their product doesn’t work in China, I understand the difficulties of circumnavigating the great firewall. But just be honest and put a disclaimer on your product, tell people that it is not suitable for use in China. Don’t lie to people, that’s only fair.

reviews.title: Auto connect imperfect
reviews.text:
Auto connect doesn’t always work. I usually have to manually connect/disconnect the VPN whether I am on a trusted network or not. I think it may help to always have the app open, but even that doesn’t always work. I also have my auto connect set to certain connections, but it doesn’t always default to the one I’ve set. Sometimes the VPN will disconnect and my connection to a wifi will stay as well. This is a security risk and inconvenience as I’m expecting the connection to stay unless I switch networks or disconnect the VPN. Once in a while there will be interruptions to my connection as well, and I’m not sure if it’s because of the provider or the VPN is just working poorly at certain times. Occasionally it won’t work either on my devices, so I have to disconnect it entirely. Lastly, I will say the VPN works fine 99% of the time. The connection stays, is fast, and I’m sure it keeps you protected. However, that 1% is extremely important. I would rather experience a connection interruption than a security risk. I’m not sure how the other VPNs are, but this one is okay. It doesn’t deserve 4 stars though.

Update March 2026: dropping my review down to 1 star due to a recent change that ruined the mobile VPN. The autoconnect/trusted network feature is completely broken and has likely exposed me to much more risk than it should have. If there are any decent VPN providers that are privacy first, I will switch in a heartbeat. This one has failed to maintain consistent protection. I
